relationships.subject: MAO-B inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: iMAO-Bs blunted cytokine secretion and NLRP3 inflammasome activation through inhibition of the NF-κB and STAT3 pathways

relationships.subject: MAO-B inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: iMAO-Bs blunted the release of proinflammatory cytokines (interleukin [IL]-6 and IL1-β)

key_findings: MAO-B inhibitors rasagiline and safinamide reduced cytokines, chemokines and ankle swelling in murine CPP crystal arthritis.
Effect involves reduced ROS, NF-kB/STAT3 and NLRP3 inflammasome activation in macrophages.
